nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 23 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine one current early observation (06:06 WAT, 24 Nov) and one previous-close observation (23 Nov, 13:29 WAT); the previous-close value is not a current-day quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.
